title: Transcribe Video
description: Timestamped transcript with speakers: JSON (segments + words, seconds with 3 decimals) and SRT.

choices.label: On
choices.hint: who speaks each line (pyannote on Zoro)

choices.label: Off
choices.hint: every line SPEAKER_00, a little faster

hints: Outputs are in /history under outputs['12']['transcripts']: one .json and one .srt item {filename, subfolder, type: output}.
Word times come only from forced alignment. Words the aligner cannot spell (digits, symbols) have start/end null.
Paste the episode script into SCRIPT so names are spelled right.

Speaker labels are on by default (pyannote speaker-diarization-community-1 on Zoro): lines come back as SPEAKER_00, SPEAKER_01... in order of first speech. 12.min_speakers / 12.max_speakers (0 = find it) help when the count is known.
Language hi gives Hindi word times (indicwav2vec-hindi aligner).
